notes.content: Cal Poly Humboldt's BA in Interdisciplinary Studies with a concentration in Leadership Studies is composed of upper division major courses. There are no lower division prerequisites for the courses in the major. The courses are 100% online. To learn more, contact the Department at https://extended.humboldt.edu/leadership-studies Preparation: This is a degree completion program designed for upper division transfer students and working adults who want to customize their learning experience to align with their current professional goals. An associates degree is NOT required to be admitted to the Leadership Studies major, although many applicants do have an associates degree prior to applying. To be admitted, applicants must complete -- before the application term -- at least 60 and up to 70 units of lower division coursework with at least a 2.0 cumulative grade point average based on their transferable work. Within those 60-70 units, they must complete at least 30 units of general education (GE) coursework with grades of C- or higher. As part of those 30 GE units, they must complete, with C- or better, all four of these subject areas: Written Communication (English Composition); Oral Communication (Public Speaking); Critical Thinking; and Mathematics/Quantitative Reasoning. For more information on how to apply: https://extended.humboldt.edu/leadership-studies/apply Fee Structure: Students pay per course instead of paying full time or part time tuition rates. Because the Leadership Studies Program is delivered by the College Extended Education & Global Engagement, students are not subject to HSU state fees. Self-support programs do not receive tax dollars from the State. Therefore, please be aware that State University Grants, Cal Grants and fee waivers cannot be applied to pay for this program. Federal Pell Grants and Federal Student Loans MAY be applied. For more information about the program cost, visit the resources above.
